verdict.rationale: Lium ships an official `lium` CLI, installed with `pip install lium.io`. It covers renting with a TTL (`lium up`), remote exec that returns the remote exit code for agent scripting, quoting, spend tracking, file copy and clusters. The docs include a CLI reference, and a probe confirms the official GitHub repo. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of CLI behavior beyond vendor docs and the vendor's own repo.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: pip install lium.io && lium up --gpu H100 --ttl 1h# auto-removes after 1h
lium exec job "nvidia-smi"                              # exits with the remote command's exit code
From the terminal: `lium clusters up <fabric> --nodes N --name <name>`
lium spend                                     # burn per hour, spend per pod, runway
